method_direction: depth-assisted geometric correction of RGB teacher pseudo-labels, followed by RGB-only student distillation
why_this_direction: every self-training arm so far changed which frames were kept, never the teacher's predicted coordinates. The student therefore inherits the teacher's structured geometric error. Depth is a measurement independent of the teacher, so it is the first signal that could correct the coordinates themselves rather than reselect frames.
gate0_question: is the depth in the existing unlabelled real recordings synchronised, scaled, calibrated and dense enough on the pallet to support metric geometric correction

gate0_thresholds_declared_before_results.calibration: every recording intended for the method must have a known depth metric scale AND either a confirmed aligned-to-color contract or depth intrinsics plus depth-to-color extrinsics
gate0_thresholds_declared_before_results.usable_support_definition: valid depth pixels >= max(200, 5% of ROI pixel count); this only says there are enough depth samples to attempt a geometric fit, not that a fit would be accurate
gate0_thresholds_declared_before_results.alignment: repeated systematic RGB-depth misalignment in the visual audit fails the gate even if an automatic edge score looks good

audit_recordings.why_these: these are the existing MAIN unlabelled adaptation source recordings; evaluation source recordings are deliberately excluded from this sensor audit

forbidden_in_gate0: changing any threshold after seeing the result
choosing depth settings by looking at ground truth
reads_allowed_in_gate0: existing frozen R0 prediction cache, for pallet ROI only
a_pass_does_not_mean: that depth correction will improve accuracy. A pass means only that there is a technical basis to attempt the experiment; pseudo-label correction quality is a separate question for Gate 1.
